content.text: You’re a digital creator in Nigeria, Ghana, or Pakistan. Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle are either unavailable or functionally unusable in your country. You sell [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-sell-ebooks-kenya-step-step-deployment-guide-8|ebooks]], courses, or templates but cannot collect payment through conventional platforms. This is not a temporary inconvenience—it’s a structural exclusion baked into the global financial system. This post compares Gumroad’s platform-based solution to [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/sovereign-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-honest-side-side-8|COREMERCH guide to sovereign]] commerce infrastructure. We’ll analyze what each offers, how they handle restricted countries, payment mechanics, ownership, and automation. By the end, you’ll know which [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-digital-product-stores-kyc-payments-4|The Real]] to deploy for your situation.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Online gumroad

Gumroad is a hosted platform that handles product hosting, payment processing, and delivery in exchange for a 10% fee. It’s simple but rents you access to its infrastructure. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, by contrast, is a stack of tools you own and control. It uses GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto payment verification. You pay a one-time fee for deployment, own the stack outright, and incur no recurring fees beyond NOWPayments’ 0.5% transaction charge. Gumroad offers convenience; sovereign infrastructure offers ownership and permanence.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Gumroad relies on Stripe and PayPal for payments, both of which operate in only 46 of 195 countries. If Stripe or PayPal is unavailable in your country, Gumroad is unusable. Sovereign commerce infrastructure bypasses this restriction entirely by using NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies and requires no buyer account or KYC. It works in every country, regardless of financial sanctions or banking restrictions. Gumroad is a gated platform; sovereign infrastructure is borderless by design.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Gumroad processes payments instantly but takes 10% of every sale. PayPal, which Gumroad uses, can suspend accounts and hold funds for up to 180 days with no appeal. Sovereign infrastructure uses NOWPayments, which verifies crypto payments on-chain and fires a webhook immediately. Fees are 0.5%, and funds settle directly to your wallet. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON keep transaction costs under $0.10. Gumroad’s fees are higher and its payment reliability is lower in restricted countries.
Stripe operates in only 46 of 195 countries—sovereign infrastructure works in all of them.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With Gumroad, your products, customer data, and payment processing are hosted on Gumroad’s servers. You rent access and depend on their platform. Sovereign infrastructure gives you full ownership of your stack. Products are hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare R2, orders are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets, and delivery is automated via backend logic. Once deployed, COREMERCH has no access to your stack. You own the infrastructure, the data, and the process. Gumroad is a landlord; sovereign infrastructure is a deed.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choose Gumroad if you’re in a Stripe-supported country, prefer simplicity, and accept platform dependency. Choose sovereign commerce infrastructure if you’re in a restricted country, prioritize ownership, and want a permanent solution. If you sell digital products in Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, or similar regions, sovereign infrastructure is the only option that guarantees payment processing, data ownership, and operational autonomy. It’s more work to deploy but eliminates platform risk entirely.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe is unavailable in your country, sovereign commerce infrastructure is the best alternative to Gumroad. It uses crypto payments via NOWPayments, which works in every country and requires no buyer account or KYC. Deploy a stack with GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. This architecture bypasses Stripe and PayPal restrictions, gives you full ownership, and ensures permanent operational autonomy.
PayPal can suspend accounts and hold funds for 180 days—crypto payments settle directly to your wallet.

For those who prefer to build their own, the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) provides complete documentation and source code for all 5 stacks.
Your Deployment Checklist

Deploy your sovereign commerce stack in these steps: 1. Choose a hosting platform—GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 2. Set up backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 3. Configure order storage using Supabase or Google Sheets. 4. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment verification. 5. Load your products and test end-to-end functionality. 6. Configure email deliverability with SPF/DKIM/DMARC. 7. Launch your store and retain full ownership of your infrastructure.

PayPal is available in Nigeria and Ghana but severely restricted. Account suspensions are common, and funds can be held for up to 180 days with no appeal. In Pakistan, PayPal is unavailable entirely. Sovereign commerce infrastructure using NOWPayments is a more reliable alternative, as it supports 300+ cryptocurrencies and requires no buyer account or KYC.
